How does SCRIPE enforce zero-trust Multi-Tenant Identity, Federated SSO, Hybrid MFA, and runtime security?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE eliminates pre-auth filter leaks, unverified SSO linking, and dead security tables by enforcing cryptographic proofs, encrypted IDs, and live middleware checks across every tenant and module.1

  1. Pre-auth and cross-tenant lookups bypass ambient tenant filters safely with explicit !IsDeleted, lockout, and tenant-status checks.2
  2. External IDs resolve exclusively through EncryptedGuidModelBinder or _idEncryption.TryDecrypt, failing closed (422/404) instead of falling back to Platform scope.3
  3. Apple, Microsoft, Google, OIDC, OAuth2, and SAML verify signatures, sub, and email_verified before HybridMfaPolicy issues a single-use TwoFactorPendingToken.4
  4. PersonalAccessTokenAuthenticationHandler, ApiKeyUsageMiddleware, AdminPermissionCache, and TrustedCidrEnforcementMiddleware enforce PATs, API keys, delegations, and CIDRs live.5

How do SCRIPE's Identity Provider, Federated SSO, and Runtime Guards connect?

Diagram structure
  • Login & SSO UI fe_login
  • Account & IdP UI fe_console
  • Auth, PAT & CIDR Gate edge_mw
  • OIDC, OAuth2 & SAML sso_eng
  • State & 2FA Tickets state_mfa
  • PBAC & Delegation pbac_gate
  • Identity Schema DB id_db
  • Integrations Schema DB int_db
  • fe_login → edge_mw · Encrypted IDs
  • fe_console → edge_mw · Sudo + RowVersion
  • edge_mw → sso_eng · Verify Proofs
  • edge_mw → pbac_gate · PAT & API Key
  • sso_eng → state_mfa · Nonce & 2FA
  • sso_eng → id_db · IgnoreFilters
  • pbac_gate → id_db · Live Grants
  • edge_mw → int_db · X-API-Key Log
  1. Login & SSO UI ↗

    Discovers active tenant or platform IdPs via GET /api/v1/auth/oidc/providers/admin and runs /sso/callback and passwordless 2FA step-up.

  2. Account & IdP UI ↗

    Renders live availableSsoProviders, enforces Sudo for linking/passkeys, and edits IdPs with RowVersion concurrency on /settings/identity-providers and /tenants/[id].

  3. Auth, PAT & CIDR Gate ↗

    Runs PersonalAccessTokenAuthenticationHandler, ApiKeyUsageMiddleware, CookieAuthMiddleware, and TrustedCidrEnforcementMiddleware across all modules.

  4. OIDC, OAuth2 & SAML ↗

    Validates JWKS ID tokens, pure OAuth2 GitHub emails, and X.509 SAML assertions without mutating shared HttpClient headers.

  5. State & 2FA Tickets ↗

    Stores single-use IExternalAuthStateStore login/link tickets and 5-minute TwoFactorPendingToken challenges in IDistributedCache.

  6. PBAC & Delegation ↗

    Intersects pat_scope claims without SystemProtected bypass and unions active AdminDelegation permissions via AdminPermissionCache.

Every authentication and authorization boundary enforces four non-negotiable invariants across SCRIPE-Backend and SCRIPE-Frontend.1

How do OIDC, OAuth2, SAML, and Hybrid MFA block account takeover?

Diagram structure
  • Next.js 16 SPA spa
  • Auth Controllers api
  • External IdP idp
  • State & 2FA Cache store
  • Identity DB db
  • spa → api · Initiate Login or Sudo Link
  • api → store · Save State, Nonce, PKCE & Purpose
  • api → spa · Redirect URL (Allowlisted Origin)
  • spa → idp · Authenticate at External IdP
  • idp → spa · Callback Code or SAML Assertion
  • spa → api · POST Callback (Code + State)
  • api → store · Consume Single-Use State Ticket
  • api → idp · Verify JWKS Signature or X.509 Cert
  • api → db · Lookup (ProviderId, sub) First
  • db → api · Admin + Tenant + Lockout Status
  • api → store · Issue 5-Min TwoFactorPendingToken
  • api → spa · 200 Requires2FA (Empty Tokens)
  • spa → api · POST /2fa/verify (TOTP + Ticket)
  • api → spa · Access JWT + HttpOnly Refresh Cookie
  1. State & 2FA Cache ↗

    Consumes state, nonce, PKCE codeVerifier, and purpose (login or link) once from IDistributedCache.

  2. External IdP ↗

    Verifies issuer JWKS with MapInboundClaims = false or mandatory X.509 cert with AllowedAudienceUris and InResponseTo.

  3. Identity DB ↗

    Matches (IdentityProviderId, ProviderKey) first, rejects subject-swap (sso.subjectMismatch), and auto-links only if EmailVerified is true.

  4. Auth Controllers ↗

    Checks HybridMfaPolicy.RequiresSecondFactor and withholds tokens until POST /api/v1/auth/{admin|user}/2fa/verify redeems the ticket.

Login updates run through UpdateLastLoginAtAsync (ExecuteUpdateAsync) so synthetic role graphs never trigger EF Core tracking collisions.6

How do Sudo-gated Account Security and Tenant IdP administration eliminate mock catalogs?

Diagram structure
  • Account UI acct_view
  • Sudo Valid? sudo_gate
  • Verify Sudo sudo_step
  • Link Ticket init_link
  • Link Admin idp_cb
  • Sole-Auth Guard sole_chk
  • acct_view → sudo_gate · link
  • idp_cb → sole_chk · unlink
  • init_link → idp_cb · callback
  • sudo_gate → init_link · yes
  • sudo_gate → sudo_step · no
  1. Account UI ↗

    Loads real availableSsoProviders from GET /api/v1/account/security honoring inherit or custom mode and slug shadowing.

  2. Sudo Valid? ↗

    Requires fresh X-Sudo-Token or HttpOnly Sudo cookie on initiate-link, DELETE unlink, and passkey registration.

  3. Link Ticket ↗

    Binds purpose = "link" and linkAdminId inside IExternalAuthStateStore; legacy direct /external-logins/link returns 410 Gone.

  4. Link Admin ↗

    OIDC returns { linked: true } without tokens; SAML 302-redirects to /sso/saml/callback?linked=1.

  5. Sole-Auth Guard ↗

    Rejects DELETE unlink with 422 when removing the admin or user's last remaining authentication method.

Both Platform Admins (/tenants/[id] via PlatformTenantIdentityProvidersController) and Tenant Admins (/settings/identity-providers) manage active IdPs with IsActive, TrustIdpMfa, RowVersion optimistic concurrency (409 refresh), and detailed test-connection diagnostics.7
